message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in the data acquisition path; data is passed directly to dataset constructors without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local directory (conf.data_dir) with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or any authentication of the data source.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the shown code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples in the data preparation pipeline shown.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained weights are loaded via torchvision's resnet34/resnet50 and pretrainedmodels with pretrained=True/'imagenet', but no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions are performed before use.
No detected label distribution validation: The code logs dataset sizes but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous-sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, gradient anomaly analysis, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any differential privacy mechanism is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a validation split (val_dataset) is created via fold-based splitting, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation of a held-out test set from training, and no use of multiple independent metrics beyond the single hierarchical_macro_averaged_recall metric.

No detected input sanitization: The code contains no input shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs on the inference data-flow path; data is passed directly through dataset/transformer pipelines without defensive validation.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks applied to model outputs anywhere in the visible inference code path.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer-vision (image classification) pipeline for Bengali handwriting recognition, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
